root_motivation: **Who:** Joe, who reads the nightly recipe row and must know whether a 0.0 is the host, the recipe text, or the task; the agent reading llms.txt, who must be able to type the section's calls and have them accepted. **What:** a recipe that cannot say one thing while the host accepts another. **Why not today:** `git ls-tree origin/main` (4e07dfd): 6 `proof.sh`, 5 llms.txt recipe sections, 4 `synthorg-task.yaml` (database, docs-qa, share-a-tool, team-memory, uptime have tests `*_ac07_synthorg_task_five_completions.rs`; chart, first-run and webhook-inbox have none), and `recipe_steps` for webhook-inbox and schedules only. The uptime section's plan claim contradicts `src/control.rs:1604`; the webhook recipe's only text is quickstart's three steps. The synthorg corpus (`corpora/mcphost/consumer-tasks.yaml:1209-1350`) paraphrases llms.txt by hand, with its own `wall_budget_s` per task (60/90). **Consequence:** the 10-07 standing rule ("generate contracts, never document them") is unmet at...
user_persona: An agent that runs host.note.put {text, attach_to: {tool}} once and reads the note on that tool's description in every later session; the same user's second client sees it too.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given `recipes/*.toml`, When `cargo xtask recipes` runs twice, Then the first run writes the sections, proof scripts, task yamls and golden tests for every recipe and the second run changes zero bytes (`git status --short` empty).
Given a hand edit of one line inside a generated llms.txt block, When `cargo test rgpt_drift`, Then it fails naming `www/llms.txt`, the recipe and the line; an edit outside the markers passes.
Given a step naming a tool absent from the keyed `tools/list` or an argument key absent from the tool's input schema, When the generator runs, Then it exits 2 and names recipe, step index and field.

Given the webhook-inbox toml, When generated, Then `www/llms.txt` contains a webhook section, `examples/webhook-inbox/proof.sh` exists, and `tests/rgpt_webhook_inbox_golden_path.rs` passes against `TestServer` with the signed-POST fixture.
Given every golden test, When `cargo test rgpt_` runs, Then each recipe's exact calls execute in order, every `expect` holds, and no single recipe exceeds 60 s.

Given the synthorg corpus with one recipe task whose `wall_budget_s` differs from the generated yaml, When `scripts/recipe-task-sync-check.sh` runs, Then it exits 1 and prints the task id and both values; with no drift it exits 0.
Given a PR that breaks one recipe step (fixture route renamed), When CI runs, Then the `recipes-golden-path` job fails on that recipe only and the job finished within 6 minutes.

scope: src/notes.rs: host.note.put/list/delete over the notes/ prefix of tenant_state_kv; the tools/list description suffix.
src/handler.rs, src/protocol/frames.rs: tools, dispatch, list_changed on a tool-attached put/delete (keyed row allows list_changed).
src/plans.rs, src/retention.rs, src/db.rs: notes_max plan field; expired-note sweep.
contracts/, docs/, www/: regenerated tool contract, output schemas, docs.
non_goals: Notes attached to runs surfaced in host.runs.get (R6), attached_to in host.resume/welcome_back (R5), pin (R7); shared notebooks across tenants.

additional.engine_form: mcphost-qjs subprocess in the python bwrap profile; cold_p95_ms measured by jsk_ac01

five_whys_trace.q: Why does the next session repeat a mistake the last one learned from?
five_whys_trace.a: The only write path is remember at signup; nothing pins a note to the tool it is about.
